# A query under a node of a slot's body asks once, on every target.
#
# Each answer writes what the slot renders, and the slot -- a tab's panel
# holding a select, which is not lifted -- renders again. An instance under
# a node of the body was built afresh by every render, so each answer asked
# for every book again and the answers never stopped: on gtk4 a page of
# names never finished arriving. It is kept across renders now, as one at
# the top of the body is.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import async "sngl:async"
import http "sngl:http"
import json "sngl:json"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

const server = "http://127.0.0.1:47819"

struct Book {
    title string
}

// A book, asked of the harness's server.
func fetchBook(title string) async.Result[Book] {
    match var r = http.get(url="{server}/books/{http.pathEscape(title)}") {
        failed { return {failed=r} }
        ok {
            match var checked = r.checked() {
                failed { return {failed=checked} }
                ok { return json.decode[Book](checked.body) }
            }
        }
    }
}

component page ui.node {
    var tab = 0
    var loads = 0
    var kind = "Red"

    ui.tabs #tabs(:selected=tab) {
        ui.tab(label="First") {
            ui.text(value="first")
        }
        ui.tab(label="Second") {
            ui.vbox {
                for var title = ["dune", "war and peace"] {
                    async.query(on=title, fetch=func(t string) => fetchBook(t), @load(got) { loads += 1 })
                }
                ui.select #pick(:value=kind) {
                    ui.choice(label="Red")
                    ui.choice(label="Green")
                }
                ui.text #count(value="{loads}")
            }
        }
    }
}

ui.window {
    page()
}

func testEachBookIsAskedForOnce(t test.Test, c page) {
    c.tabs.change(1)
    t.wait(func() => c.loads >= 2, 5000)
    t.wait(func() => c.loads > 2, 1000)
    t.assert(c.loads == 2)
    t.assert(c.count != null && c.count.value == "2")
}
